name: Holiday Whole Cranberry & Orange Relish (Skins, Seeds & Acid Warning)
whyItWorks: Raw chopped cranberries contain tough insoluble outer skins and seeds, and the fresh orange zest/juice adds harsh citric acid. Irritates ulcerated intestines.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Trigger warning item: avoid during flares. Use smooth, strained jellied canned cranberry sauce instead.
watchOuts: Raw cranberry skins and orange citric acid irritate mucosal tissue
